acceptance: Primary/secondary endpoints and optional failover are explicit.
Automatic failover rejects mismatched instance IDs.
API-key values are never persisted in WebView state.

acceptance: Human, agent, service, and API-key principals are distinguishable.

Manifest note (purpose): Complete, duplicate-aware creation manifest for the extended migration scope. It includes existing-object references and proposed new Task/Subtask/Sprint objects.
Manifest note (direct_cli_import_supported): False

Manifest note (reason): tk t batch imports Tasks only. tk p import creates a new Project. The current CLI has no safe batch operation to apply nested Task/Subtask/Sprint objects to an existing Project and map existing Category IDs.

Manifest note (safe_application): Do not pass this file to tk t batch or tk p import. A future importer should validate the whole manifest, resolve existing references, preview changes, enforce dependencies and four-direct-Sprint capacity, then apply atomically or report partial failure with IDs.

Manifest note (estimates): Each proposed Sprint is initially bounded to 30 minutes (1800 seconds); these are planning slices, not claims that a whole feature fits in one Sprint. Split a slice further if implementation exceeds its estimate.
Manifest note (sprint_shorthand): For compact entries under new_tasks, each Sprint string expands to {name: <string>, estimated_duration_seconds: 1800, buffer_pct: 0}.

Manifest note (status_policy): Only create entries marked create. Entries marked reuse are already tracked and must be continued in place. Conditional entries remain deferred until their stated decision, credentials, or contracts are available.
Resolve existing IDs and current status immediately before applying; this manifest is a point-in-time plan and may be stale.
Never reopen completed Tasks for unrelated new scope; create a new Task or add only within an open owning Task.
A Task/Subtask may own at most four direct Sprints, including terminal history. Check capacity before adding each Sprint.
Each Sprint must be started before completion and completed only with observed implementation/test evidence.
Keep external provider work deferred until required contracts, credentials, and approvals exist; do not fabricate integrations or secrets.
Do not retire the legacy UI, deploy, or change production endpoints as part of merely applying this plan.
